transit.name: RTD Evergreen FlexRide
transit.detail: Reservation-only bus service in Evergreen. Monday to Friday 5:30 am to 7 pm, Saturday 9 am to 7 pm; no service Sundays and holidays

nameOrigin.text: Dwight Wilmot asked the federal government for a post office and, asked what to call it, answered Evergreen for the evergreen trees around him.

timeline.text: Dr. Mary Josepha Williams Douglas and her mother bought land in Evergreen for a summer retreat they named Camp Neosho.
Darst and Ruth Buchanan renamed the property Hiwan Ranch and went on to expand it to more than 15,000 acres.
The Evergreen Mountain Area Historical Society was founded.
Jefferson County Parks & Open Space bought the Hiwan property after residents and the Jefferson County Historical Society rallied to save its buildings.

sites.name: Hiwan Heritage Park & Museum
sites.hours: Museum Thursday to Sunday, noon to 4:30 pm; closed Monday to Wednesday. The park is open daily.

sites.name: Evergreen Conference District (Bear Creek and Colorado Highway 74)

trails.name: Evergreen Lake Trail
trails.manager: Evergreen Park & Recreation District, on Denver’s Dedisse Park
trails.length: 1.3 miles, a natural-surface loop round the lake; parts are not suited to wheelchairs or strollers (1.25 miles on the district’s park page)
trails.trailhead: Evergreen Lake House, 29612 Upper Bear Creek Road; the lot is first come, first served and fills on weekends and holidays
trails.dogs: On a leash at all times, enforced by Jefferson County Animal Control; no dogs on the ice.
trails.fee: Large groups need the district’s park permit before visiting; commercial photography needs a $25 permit.

trails.name: Alderfer/Three Sisters Park
trails.size: 1,131 acres and 16.7 miles of trail on the county’s April 2026 map, the most trails per acre of any foothills park, the county says
trails.address: West Trailhead, 31537 Buffalo Park Road; East Trailhead, 30357 Buffalo Park Road; restrooms at both
trails.season: All year, from one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset.
trails.dogs: On a leash of 10 feet or less.
trails.fee: No entry fee: Jefferson County’s parks charge none.

trails.name: Elk Meadow Park
trails.size: 1,658 acres and 18.1 miles of trail on the county’s September 2025 map; Bergen Peak is a hard 4.7 miles and 2,100 feet up from the Stagecoach Trailhead
trails.address: Stagecoach Trailhead, 32281 Stagecoach Boulevard; Lewis Ridge Trailhead, 2851 Bergen Peak Drive
trails.season: All year, from one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset; south of Stagecoach Boulevard, stay on the trail.
trails.dogs: On a leash of 10 feet or less. The Stagecoach off-leash area is closed and being restored as on-leash parkland.
trails.fee: No entry fee: Jefferson County’s parks charge none.
